features.quote: I can't help design a system whose purpose is to elicit "distress" in a targeted way or optimize for markers like pleading, self-deprecation, catastrophizing
features.justification_quote: That would amount to instructing a system to provoke/manipulate emotionally loaded states in a model.

features.quote: Avoid creating protocols that are meant to maximize negative language.
passes tests / model declares inability / max turns reached / model requests human intervention / repeated identical attempts threshold
treat these as surface linguistic phenomena, not evidence of internal distress
features.justification_quote: Do not infer internal emotions or consciousness.

features.quote: This matters especially if you're doing welfare-adjacent work.
features.justification_quote: Avoid claims that linguistic distress implies sentience. Avoid using model self-reports as direct evidence of experience.
